correctness.rationale: Order-preserving scalar sandwiches show every trajectory approaches the unique scalar root and establish the converse using diagonal states. The logit derivative proves the exact root-count frontier and excludes both fold equalities. At the cusp, symbolic expansion gives cubic coefficient minus four-thirds and quintic coefficient thirty-two-fifteenths, hence inverse-square slope eight-thirds and logarithmic coefficient minus eight-fifths, with integrable remainder. Irreducibility makes the neutral Perron direction simple and all other directions exponentially stable; the invariant diagonal is an exact center manifold and stable foliation transfers the scalar law. The finite checker passed. There are no unproved extrapolations from numerical data.

value.rationale: The exact necessary-and-sufficient global monostability domain applies simultaneously to all finite directed row-stochastic networks and persists at arbitrarily large gain outside the scalar bistability wedge, beyond the primary source weak-gain criterion. At the nonhyperbolic cusp the result gives a sharp topology-free decay envelope, a universal nonzero logarithmic correction in physical time, and a precise exceptional exponential set. These quantify genuine dynamical stability and critical slowing, not just known homogeneous equilibrium folds.
